candidates.reason: Directly removes finality counters from Admiral Brass reanimation targets, allowing high-impact Pirates to die normally and become future targets; noncreature tap ability is usable the turn it enters.
Can remove finality counters and draw, but summoning sickness delays a newly cast Diviner and it is a non-Pirate body competing with the same utility slot.
Surveil/escape value overlaps an already dense recursion package and consumes four-mana setup before escape costs.
Outlaw mass recursion overlaps Living Death, Patriarch's Bidding and Victimize rather than improving the commander's repeatable combat reanimation.
Combat filtering can seed Pirates but requires equipment/equip setup and is less direct than finality-counter management.
Utility recursion land imposes mana/tempo costs against a premium three-color mana base; no demonstrated need for another expensive recursion line.
Repeatable self-mill is slow and colorless-intensive; commander, Entomb, Buried Alive and looting already provide stronger setup.
Evasive Pirate interaction is useful but does not outperform the existing high-impact reanimation targets or solve finality reuse.
Strong Pirate interaction but current removal/ETB Pirate suite is already dense; no defensible cut beats Power Conduit's unique commander synergy.
ETB life loss and menace are relevant but do not improve the recurring graveyard loop enough to displace current top-end Pirates.

red_team_findings.claim: Power Conduit can be dead without a Brass-reanimated creature carrying a finality counter.
red_team_findings.resolution: Its floor is narrow, but its ceiling uniquely converts one-shot commander recursion into repeatable graveyard access; only one slot is devoted to the effect.

red_team_findings.claim: Cutting Revel in Riches removes a Treasure engine and independent win condition.
red_team_findings.resolution: The project prioritizes commander identity; the deck retains multiple combat/reanimation conversion routes and Revel does not advance Brass's recursion engine.

red_team_findings.claim: Leaning harder on repeatable reanimation increases vulnerability to graveyard interaction.
red_team_findings.resolution: The swap does not reduce existing interaction/protection and only deepens a strategy the commander inherently requires; generic alternate wins are not retained solely to hedge identity.

red_team_findings.claim: The returned Pirate does not exist with a finality counter until Brass's beginning-of-combat trigger resolves.
red_team_findings.resolution: Conduit is activated only after the reanimation trigger resolves; as a noncreature permanent its tap ability is not restricted by summoning sickness.

red_team_findings.claim: Animate Dead, Reanimate, Victimize, Living Death and Patriarch's Bidding could eclipse the commander.
red_team_findings.resolution: Those effects are complementary recovery; blueprint and Pirate density retain Brass's beginning-of-combat Pirate reanimation as the defining repeatable engine.

commander_necessity.thesis: Admiral Brass mills four on entry and repeatedly turns graveyarded Pirates into hasty base-4/4 attackers at beginning of combat; finality-counter management allows selected targets to become reusable rather than one-shot.

evidence_dimensions.name: commander_identity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Power Conduit uniquely exploits the finality counter created by Admiral Brass.

evidence_dimensions.name: engine
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Pirate graveyard setup, beginning-of-combat recursion and high-impact Pirate targets remain coherent.

evidence_dimensions.name: mana
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Two-mana colorless replacement lowers the slot from Revel in Riches at five mana; mana base otherwise unchanged.

evidence_dimensions.name: interaction
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Existing premium interaction and interactive Pirate ETBs are unchanged.

evidence_dimensions.name: resilience
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Removing finality counters allows selected Pirates to return to the graveyard for reuse, improving engine resilience when Conduit survives.

evidence_dimensions.name: conversion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Reanimated Pirates retain ETB/attack/combat value; broad recursion remains as recovery/closing support.

evidence_dimensions.name: combo_integrity
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No infinite combo is asserted; finality-counter replacement and Power Conduit timing are bounded and explicitly described.

evidence_dimensions.name: card_quality
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Ten serious alternatives were dispositioned against the existing package.

evidence_dimensions.name: candidate_exhaustion
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Top direct commander-synergy and recursion alternatives have explicit decisions; no unresolved high-impact HOLD remains.

evidence_dimensions.name: testing
evidence_dimensions.rationale: No fabricated multiplayer win-rate claim; one-slot identity upgrade is supported analytically.

evidence_dimensions.name: rules_confidence
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Power Conduit/finality interaction and noncreature tap timing were previously checked and preserved.

evidence_dimensions.name: source_freshness
evidence_dimensions.rationale: Current-cycle review is anchored to the frozen source plus the Oct. 13 candidate/Oracle checkpoint.
